help:
Usage: memory [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Memory system commands (Agent Hub)

Options:
  --install-completion  Install completion for the current shell.
  --show-completion     Show completion for the current shell, to copy it or
                        customize the installation.
  --help                Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  stats       Get memory statistics.
  status      Check live progressive-context delivery health.
  save        Save a learning to the memory system.
  format      Generate a standard memory episode body and compact summary.
  list        List memory episodes with pagination.
  search      Search memory for relevant episodes.
  get         Get details for one or more episodes by UUID.
  delete      Delete one or more episodes from memory.
  update      Update an episode in place (content/tier and properties).
  tag         Add/remove tags on one or more episodes without replacing...
  revisions   List immutable revision history for one episode.
  restore     Restore an episode to a historical revision.
  batch-tier  Batch update tier for multiple episodes.
  export      Export episodes as JSON.
  import      Import episodes from JSON file or directory.
  cleanup     Clean up memory system.
  seed        Seed memory episodes from markdown skill files.
help.stats:
Usage: memory stats [OPTIONS]

  Get memory statistics.

Options:
  -s, --scope <str>  Memory scope (global or project)  [default: global]
  --scope-id <str>   Scope identifier (e.g., project ID)
  -a, --all-groups   Sum across every scope/group (overrides --scope filter)
  --help             Show this message and exit.
help.status:
Usage: memory status [OPTIONS]

  Check live progressive-context delivery health.

Options:
  -s, --scope <str>         Memory scope (global or project)  [default:
                            global]
  --scope-id <str>          Scope identifier (e.g., project ID)
  --consumer-profile <str>  Consumer profile to probe  [default:
                            claude_session_start]
  --branch <str>            Optional branch for continuity-scoped probes
  --help                    Show this message and exit.
help.save:
Usage: memory save [OPTIONS] [content]

  Save a learning to the memory system.

Arguments:
  content  Learning content to save

Options:
  -S, --summary <str>             Action phrase for TOON index (10-40 chars)
  --content <str>                 Learning content to save
  --content-file <str>            Read content from a file path or '-' for
                                  stdin
  -t, --tier <str>                Injection tier (mandate, guardrail,
                                  reference)  [default: reference]
  -c, --confidence <int>          Confidence level 0-100  [default: 80]
  --context <str>                 Optional context about the learning source
  -p, --pinned                    Pin episode (always inject regardless of
                                  budget)
  -T, --trigger-types <str>       Comma-separated task types (e.g.,
                                  database,memory)
  --trigger-phases <str>          Comma-separated subtask phases
                                  (implementation,verification,cleanup,etc.)
  --context-kind <str>            Semantic context channel (policy, reference,
                                  capability, continuity, signal)
  --consumer-profiles <str>       Comma-separated consumer profiles to target
  --exclude-consumer-profiles <str>
                                  Comma-separated consumer profiles to exclude
  --agent-slugs <str>             Comma-separated agent slugs to target
  --exclude-agent-slugs <str>     Comma-separated agent slugs to exclude
  --audience-tags <str>           Comma-separated audience tags to target
  --exclude-audience-tags <str>   Comma-separated audience tags to exclude
  --tags <str>                    Comma-separated memory tags (e.g., finance-
                                  relevant,portfolio)
  -s, --scope <str>               Explicit memory scope: global, project, or
                                  agent; omitted on update preserves scope
  --scope-id <str>                Scope identifier (e.g., project ID)
  --change-reason <str>           Optional reason recorded in memory revision
                                  history
  --render-mode <str>             Per-memory render expansion: full | compact
                                  | summary. Forces L2 / L1 / L0 rendering
                                  across all consumer profiles.
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
help.format:
Usage: memory format [OPTIONS]

  Generate a standard memory episode body and compact summary.

Options:
  --topic <str>        Required compact topic header, without markdown or
                       colon  [required]
  --instruction <str>  Required primary instruction sentence  [required]
  -t, --tier <str>     Injection tier (mandate, guardrail, reference)
                       [default: reference]
  --prohibition <str>  Optional second sentence for a direct prohibition
  --why <str>          Optional brief rationale; emitted as 'Why: ...'
  -S, --summary <str>  Optional summary override (default: suggested from
                       instruction)
  --help               Show this message and exit.
help.list:
Usage: memory list [OPTIONS]

  List memory episodes with pagination.

Options:
  -l, --limit <int>  Max episodes to return (1-300)  [default: 50]
  --cursor <str>     Pagination cursor from previous response
  -t, --tier <str>   Filter by tier (mandate, guardrail, reference)
  -s, --scope <str>  Memory scope (global or project)  [default: global]
  --scope-id <str>   Scope identifier (e.g., project ID)
  --help             Show this message and exit.
help.search:
Usage: memory search [OPTIONS] {query}

  Search memory for relevant episodes.

Arguments:
  query  Search query  [required]

Options:
  -l, --limit <int>    Max results (1-300)  [default: 10]
  --min-score <float>  Minimum relevance score (0.0-1.0)  [default: 0.0]
  -t, --tier <str>     Filter by tier (mandate, guardrail, reference)
  -s, --scope <str>    Memory scope (global or project)  [default: global]
  --scope-id <str>     Scope identifier (e.g., project ID)
  --help               Show this message and exit.
help.get:
Usage: memory get [OPTIONS] {uuids}...

  Get details for one or more episodes by UUID.

Arguments:
  uuids...  Episode UUID(s) to retrieve  [required]

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.
help.delete:
Usage: memory delete [OPTIONS] {uuids}...

  Delete one or more episodes from memory.

Arguments:
  uuids...  Episode UUID(s) to delete  [required]

Options:
  --change-reason <str>  Optional reason recorded in memory revision history
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
help.update:
Usage: memory update [OPTIONS] {uuid}

  Update an episode in place (content/tier and properties).

Arguments:
  uuid  Episode UUID (full or 8-char prefix)  [required]

Options:
  -c, --content <str>             New content for the episode
  --content-file <str>            Read content from a file path or '-' for
                                  stdin
  -t, --tier <str>                New tier (mandate/guardrail/reference)
  -S, --summary <str>             Update summary (10-40 chars for TOON index)
  --trigger-types <str>           Comma-separated task types
                                  (backend,frontend,database,etc.)
  --trigger-phases <str>          Comma-separated subtask phases
                                  (implementation,verification,cleanup,etc.)
  --pinned / --no-pinned          Pin episode (always inject regardless of
                                  budget)
  --context-kind <str>            Semantic context channel (policy, reference,
                                  capability, continuity, signal)
  --consumer-profiles <str>       Comma-separated consumer profiles to target
  --exclude-consumer-profiles <str>
                                  Comma-separated consumer profiles to exclude
  --agent-slugs <str>             Comma-separated agent slugs to target
  --exclude-agent-slugs <str>     Comma-separated agent slugs to exclude
  --audience-tags <str>           Comma-separated audience tags to target
  --exclude-audience-tags <str>   Comma-separated audience tags to exclude
  --clear-applicability           Remove all applicability
                                  targeting/exclusions
  --tags <str>                    Replace episode tags with a comma-separated
                                  list
  --clear-tags                    Remove all tags from the episode
  --change-reason <str>           Optional reason recorded in memory revision
                                  history
  --render-mode <str>             Per-memory render expansion: full | compact
                                  | summary. Pass 'auto' (or 'clear') to
                                  revert to profile-driven tiering. Omit to
                                  leave unchanged.
  -s, --scope <str>               Explicit memory scope: global, project, or
                                  agent; omitted on update preserves scope
  --scope-id <str>                Scope identifier (e.g., project ID)
  --help                          Show this message and exit.
help.tag:
Usage: memory tag [OPTIONS] {uuids}...

  Add/remove tags on one or more episodes without replacing the full list.

Arguments:
  uuids...  Episode UUID(s) to retrieve  [required]

Options:
  --add-tags <str>     Comma-separated tags to add
  --remove-tags <str>  Comma-separated tags to remove
  --help               Show this message and exit.
help.revisions:
Usage: memory revisions [OPTIONS] {uuid}

  List immutable revision history for one episode.

Arguments:
  uuid  Episode UUID (full or 8-char prefix)  [required]

Options:
  -l, --limit <int>  Max revisions to return (1-100)  [default: 20]
  --help             Show this message and exit.
help.restore:
Usage: memory restore [OPTIONS] {uuid} {revision_id}

  Restore an episode to a historical revision.

Arguments:
  uuid         Episode UUID (full or 8-char prefix)  [required]
  revision_id  Revision UUID to restore to  [required]

Options:
  --change-reason <str>  Optional reason recorded in memory revision history
  --help                 Show this message and exit.
help.batch-tier:
Usage: memory batch-tier [OPTIONS] [uuids]...

  Batch update tier for multiple episodes.

Arguments:
  uuids...  UUIDs to update (when using --tier)

Options:
  -f, --file <path>  JSON file with updates [{uuid, tier}]
  -j, --json <str>   JSON string with updates
  -t, --tier <str>   Tier to apply to all UUIDs
  --help             Show this message and exit.
help.export:
Usage: memory export [OPTIONS] [uuids]...

  Export episodes as JSON. Use directory path (no extension) for tier-split
  files.

Arguments:
  uuids...  Specific UUIDs to export (optional)

Options:
  -t, --tier <str>     Filter by tier (mandate, guardrail, reference)
  -o, --output <path>  Output file or directory (no extension = directory with
                       tier-split files)
  -f, --full           Export all fields (default: minimal fields for tune_it)
  -s, --scope <str>    Memory scope (global or project)  [default: global]
  --scope-id <str>     Scope identifier (e.g., project ID)
  --help               Show this message and exit.
help.import:
Usage: memory import [OPTIONS] {input_path}

  Import episodes from JSON file or directory. Directories process all .json
  files.

Arguments:
  input_path  JSON file or directory to import (from st memory export)
              [required]

Options:
  --dry-run  Show what would change without applying
  --help     Show this message and exit.
help.cleanup:
Usage: memory cleanup [OPTIONS]

  Clean up memory system.

Options:
  --orphaned         Clean up orphaned edges (stale episode refs)
  --stale            Clean up stale memories not accessed within TTL
  --ttl-days <int>   TTL in days for stale cleanup (default 30)  [default: 30]
  -s, --scope <str>  Memory scope (global or project)  [default: global]
  --scope-id <str>   Scope identifier (e.g., project ID)
  --help             Show this message and exit.
help.seed:
Usage: memory seed [OPTIONS] {directory}

  Seed memory episodes from markdown skill files.

  Reads .md files with YAML frontmatter from a directory and upserts them as
  memory episodes. Uses skill:<filename> tag for idempotent re-seeding.

Arguments:
  directory  Directory containing .md skill files  [required]

Options:
  --dry-run            Show what would change without applying
  -p, --project <str>  Project name for scoping
  -s, --scope <str>    Memory scope (global or project)  [default: global]
  --scope-id <str>     Scope identifier (e.g., project ID)
  --help               Show this message and exit.

usage.when: durable learning surfaced; correction or validated approach
precautions: choose explicit scope: project-specific → -s project --scope-id <id>; global only for cross-project knowledge
use ST for agent memory writes; reusable instructions belong in scoped DB prompts
verify success on save; revisions are immutable

usage.when: durable rules / prior incidents / workflow history before retries
precautions: not for live code/runtime facts — use st search, pulse, db, logs
recheck scope when content changes; omitted scope preserves it
scope edits retain canonical before/after revisions and undo; inspect the saved result
